slides.title: $100 a week or all at once: what won on Bitcoin?
slides.sub: DCA vs lump sum, tested on 5 years of real prices.

slides.title: The last 12 months
paras: Buy <g>$100 of Bitcoin every week</g> since Oct 20, 2025: $5,300 in, worth <g>$5,626</g> today.
Put the same $5,300 in on day one: <r>$3,907</r>.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc. from Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes, cross-checked with CoinGecko · Oct 20, 2026

slides.title: Why weekly buys won
paras: The lump sum bought on day one, near <r>$110.6K</r>. Bitcoin then slid to $58.6K by June 30.
Every week the $100 bought a bit more. <u>Average cost: $76.8K</u>, below today's $81.5K.

slides.title: Start in 2022 instead
paras: Start the clock on Oct 20, 2022, when Bitcoin was near <g>$19K</g>, close to the bear-market bottom.
Now the lump sum wins by a mile. <u>When the price mostly rises, getting in early wins.</u>
slides.source: Hotcoin calc. from Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes

slides.title: Who wins more often
paras: Across 209 one-year windows since Oct 2021, <g>all at once won 2 out of 3 times</g>.
<u>DCA wins on regret:</u> you never put everything in at the top.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc., Yahoo Finance BTC-USD; windows start weekly. Past returns don't predict future ones.
